description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing employee leave requests within the OrangeHRM HR management system. It includes methods for retrieving, listing, creating, updating leave requests, and integrates various traits and dependencies for authorization, validation, and business logic handling.

classes.name: EmployeeLeaveRequestAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller handling leave request retrieval, creation, update, and listing for employees within the OrangeHRM system. Implements CRUD endpoints using traits for authorization, validation, and business logic.

methods.name: getLeaveAssignmentService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LeaveAssignmentService.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific leave request by ID, with support for detailed view.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Lists all leave requests based on provided filters such as date range, status, employee, and subunit, with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Creates and populates a LeaveRequestSearchFilterParams object based on query parameters for filtering leave requests.

methods.name: getDefaultIncludeEmployees
methods.description: Returns the default setting for including employee details in listing filters.

methods.name: getDefaultStatuses
methods.description: Returns the default array of statuses to filter leave requests.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getOne' endpoint, requiring a positive leaveRequestId and optional model parameter.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getAll' endpoint, including access control for employee IDs and filter parameters.

methods.name: getCommonFilterParamRuleCollection
methods.description: Builds and returns common validation rules for filtering leave requests, including dates, statuses, subunit IDs, and sorting.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for creating a new leave request, ensuring required body parameters and employee access.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new leave request, resolving leave assignment and returning the created resource.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for updating a leave request, including action and model parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the status or details of an existing leave request based on an action specified in the request body.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws a not supported exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws a not supported exception.
